title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - UsageConsumptionReport
description: An usage consumption report enables to know at a given point the balances and the consumption counters related to various buckets (SMS, Voice, Data for example). It could be calculated for a device identified by a public key (msisdn number for a mobile device for example or PSTN or VOIP number for a fix device), for a subscribed offer or option or for an user. (TM Forum TMF677 Usage Consumption 5.1.0, OpenAPI component UsageConsumptionReport; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

valueName.description: Value of the counter in a formatted string used for display needs for example
